title: 14 Year Old Sisters Learning Their Lesson The Hard Way
description:
On June 16th, 2023, officers were dispatched in reference to juveniles running away. Their parents informed the police that they had caught them smoking marijuana and had smacked them, which must have caused them to run away. Later, the girls' stepmother called the officer. The parents informed the officers that they believed the girls were in a nearby residence. The police tried to make contact, but nobody answered the door. In the morning, one of the parents found a girl and suspected a man to be responsible for her running away. Both parents were not in a very good mood, and the officers had to calm them down. Shortly afterward, the officers found the other girl as well. Both of them were charged for running away while Brianna was additionally charged with resisting.
